Operating principles

Campaigns stay closed until required disclosures are complete and an owner approves publication. Staff cannot approve their own expenses or participant stories.

Payment records come from verified Bachs events. Reconciliation records compare confirmed payments with USD bank receipts. Refund records are accounting adjustments after verification in Bachs; they do not issue money.

Audit history records successful administrative changes. Pagination shows up to 100 records at a time.

Use the Supabase dashboard to invite staff and assign roles. No public registration or role-assignment route exists.
